theme: An open day with three trip deadlines to clear.
greeting: The calendar's empty today, Dan — no meetings to work around. The day's real work is the Croatia trip: two bookings are due today and the last Dubrovnik night is still open.

needsAttention.title: Close the St. Pete landing-night gap
needsAttention.detail: Sept 20-21, the two nights between your TPA landing and the kids' Sept 22 pickup, are still unbooked. The p1 task is due today. Also glance that the St Pete Airbnb request converted from pending to confirmed.

needsAttention.title: Confirm Croatia checked bags in writing
needsAttention.detail: The issued ticket shows zero checked bags on Basic Economy. The p1 due today is to verify baggage on Eurowings Discover's own site with the record locator and pre-buy now — airport fees run well above the online price.

needsAttention.title: Book the last Dubrovnik night, Sept 19
needsAttention.detail: The single night after disembarking the charter, near the airport in Cavtat, is still open. P1, due Aug 23.

flagged.title: New MyChart message
flagged.detail: MaineHealth posted a new secure message to your MyChart portal; it's a notification only, so the message itself sits behind the portal login.

inbox.noise: The rest is newsletters, receipts (Apple, Curb), a LinkedIn job digest, and a Maine sourdough order.

recipe.title: Salmon Baked in Foil
recipe.why: A light foil-wrapped supper that lets high-summer herbs and lemon carry the plate.

acts.line: Nothing on the calendar — the open stretch is the moment to clear the two trip bookings due today.
The girls are with you and Mike in St. Pete; the afternoon is unclaimed beyond the Croatia prep.
A quiet evening at the Kenwood place, with nothing scheduled to bump against.
